value.rationale: D4 is the first irreducible classical type-D case; its canonical order-reversing Kreweras symmetry is central to Catalan cyclic sieving. The exact ordinary quotient changes torsion-free shellable order-complex topology into a 3-primary fundamental group and isolates two free degree-two directions. This is a complete homotopy classification of a natural symmetry quotient, rather than a routine normalization, table recomputation or arbitrary parameter slice.
